design.repetitions_semantics: Independent development processes; provider sampling seed is unavailable and is not claimed controlled
design.case_policy: The same complete fixed case is used for process feedback and final replay within each task
design.feedback_policy: n is a maximum accepted process-evaluation count; unused budget is allowed; accepted candidate failures count and return zero
design.final_policy: Replay the single deadline-frozen candidate; never select the best candidate from feedback history
